user_message: Determine which rights are actually available and whether cash can meet the filed puts. A later indicative share price is not part of the trigger window. Report remaining shares only under the stated conditional voluntary-conversion assumption; do not assume holders’ future choices. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. sources.text: Synthetic packet: The synthetic note register contains validated notices and the complete final eligible close window. Cash restrictions and facility fees are binding at the put deadline.

Synthetic governing terms: Amounts are USD millions and shares are millions. The issuer may force conversion only after at least20 of the final30 eligible closes are at least130% of conversion price. Holders who submitted valid put notices must receive cash principal plus simple accrued annual coupon; the issuer cannot override those notices with stock. Remaining holders may voluntarily convert principal only. The put and any conversions occur simultaneously after the eligible window.

outputs.name: qualifying_close_count
outputs.description: Closes meeting the inclusive trigger within the supplied eligible 30-day window.

outputs.name: call_trigger_price
outputs.description: Share-price threshold for each qualifying close.

outputs.name: forced_conversion_available
outputs.description: Whether the issuer’s call-trigger count is met.

outputs.name: put_cash_required
outputs.description: Cash principal and accrued coupon due on valid put notices.

outputs.name: remaining_conversion_shares
outputs.description: New shares if all principal not put voluntarily converts; no coupon is delivered in shares.

outputs.name: additional_cash_needed
outputs.description: Cash required beyond unrestricted cash and net facility proceeds.
